Definition: to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pray, entreat, supplicate; 1a) (Qal) to pray, entreat; 1b) (Niphal) to be supplicated, be entreated; 1c) (Hiphil) to make supplication, plead
